name: diesel_i4_4l5_turbo
source: Plausible 4.5 L 4-cylinder turbo-diesel of the mid-size tractor class, NOT a specific engine: rated about 100 kW at 2200 rpm, peak 580 N*m at 1500 rpm (torque rise ~32%), matching published brochure ranges for this class (rated 90-105 kW at 2100-2300 rpm, 520-600 N*m at 1400-1600 rpm; e.g. the John Deere PowerTech 4045 / Deutz TCD 4.1 class - verify before citing). In I3 the throttle channel is direct fuel demand; the governor droop above rated speed is modelled with the soft_cut limiter (full fuel at 2200, zero fuel at 2400 high idle, ~9% regulation). The all-speed governor with hand_throttle arrives in I4 (PHYS-033 section 5.3). Motoring = friction only (unthrottled diesel), fmep ~1.2-2.0 bar scaled by V_d/(4*pi) = 35.8 N*m/bar. Inertia 1.2 kg*m^2 incl. heavy flywheel. PHYS-033 I3.
